description.value: The Blowhole is a natural coastal feature within Naikoon Provincial Park on Haida Gwaii, situated on the traditional territory of the Haida Nation near the northeastern tip of the island. Naikoon Park encompasses over 100 km of expansive remote beach and wilderness, making it a remarkable destination for adventurous touring cyclists who have made the journey to this remote archipelago. The surrounding wilderness is characterized by moist Pacific rainforest, dramatic headlands, and culturally significant Haida heritage sites.
